scientific_question: Among fully species-disjoint Lepidoptera, does similarity in native larval host-resource geography predict greater congruence of post-IBD spatial genetic structure after sampling geometry is controlled?

primary_predictor.name: native_host_resource_geography_similarity
primary_predictor.definition: Jaccard similarity between the frozen WCVP-v13 native, extant, non-doubtful WGSRPD level-3 host-resource footprint sets of the target and source species
primary_predictor.host_species_weighting: union over distinct WCVP-resolved larval host species; duplicate HOSTS records do not increase weight

pairwise_transfer_surface.response: pairwise congruence of endpoint-safe post-IBD edge responses
pairwise_transfer_surface.alignment: for each target edge, choose the nearest source edge midpoint; retain only alignments with nearest distance <=500 km
pairwise_transfer_surface.cap_sampling: response-blind deterministic target-source-pair hash sampling without replacement when more than 128 target edges are eligible
pairwise_transfer_surface.pair_transfer_congruence: Pearson correlation between aligned source and target post-IBD edge responses

predictor_geometry_control.method: pooled target-fixed-effect residualization of host-resource Jaccard before response scoring
predictor_geometry_control.standardization: center predictor and covariates within target, then population-standardize geometry covariates across retained pairs

primary_statistic.per_target: Pearson correlation across supported source species between geometry-residualized host-resource Jaccard and pairwise post-IBD transfer congruence
primary_statistic.panel: arithmetic mean of finite per-target correlations

private.meaning: each species has private residual spatial structure

geometry_confounded_trap.meaning: shared spatial structure follows insect sampling geometry, not host-resource overlap

host_breadth_confounded_trap.kernel: Gaussian RBF over standardized log1p native host-resource WGSRPD3 unit count and log1p resolved larval host-species count
host_breadth_confounded_trap.meaning: shared structure follows broad resource breadth only, not which host-resource regions overlap

host_resource_gradient_positive.kernel: PSD cosine kernel of frozen binary native host-resource WGSRPD3 presence vectors
host_resource_gradient_positive.meaning: species sharing more host-resource geography share more latent residual spatial structure

inference.method: worst-case one-sided upper-tail Monte Carlo envelope across all nuisance reference distributions
inference.p_value: maximum of the +1-corrected upper-tail Monte Carlo p-values across frozen nuisance reference cells

wing_axis.reason: only 24/500 selected species and 7/235 geographically supported evaluation species have frozen LepTraits wing-size data

stopping_rules: Character-mask filtering may remove species but may not rewire graphs, relax the 50% comparable-column threshold, resplit train/eval roles, alter host footprints, or select species using Jaccard values.
Formal qualification is repeated on the exact character-mask survivor geometry using the inherited species roles and the same host footprints.
If any formal nuisance Type-I gate or positive-power gate fails on exact survivor geometry, stop before nucleotide identity and report NOT_EVALUABLE.
Do not change Jaccard, geometry covariates, pair alignment, 128-edge cap, nuisance family, synthetic amplitudes, alpha, or gates after any formal reference/evaluation statistic is inspected.
No wing-size source may be added after genetic outcomes are opened.
